# rolescan
> Watches company hiring pages for new openings, keeps a ledger so nothing is
> notified twice, and sends matches to print, a webhook or Discord. No resume
> generation, no applying, no credentials.
> Built with Natural Language Coding (NLC 0.8.0): https://github.com/Zygotic-AI/Natural-Language-Compiler

## Read, in order
- AGENTS.md — the rules (no secrets, no posting without NOTIFY, change constraints first, state under data/, run the gates)
- docs/agent-guide.md — task to files to gate map (generated from docs/tasks.json)
- README.md — quickstart and configuration
- adrs/README.md — decisions in force

## Setup
- ./setup.sh            venv, deps, .env from .env.example, filters/active.json from filters/example.json
- ./doctor.sh           CORE_READY (offline), plus LIVE_READY and BROWSER_READY as optional rows
- bin/run-once --fixtures fixtures/run1 --dry-run    first run, no keys, no network

## Gates
- bin/check.sh          compile, secret scan, doctor, tests, fixture run, clean tree
- bin/check-nlc.sh      rule coverage, rule IR, call tree (NLC 0.8.0)

## Rules that matter most
- Never commit a credential; .env stays gitignored; bin/secret-scan enforces it.
- Do not post or DM without NOTIFY; default is print (no keys).
- Filters live in filters/active.json (yours, gitignored); the shipped contract is filters/example.json.
- Runtime state lives under JOBKIT_DATA (default data/).
- Hiring.cafe is browser automation: read docs/third-party.md; captcha solving is opt-in.
